tree.heading: Federal Charter.—
tree.text: Navy Wives Clubs of America (in this chapter, the “corporation”), incorporated in California, is a federally chartered corporation.

tree.heading: Expiration of Charter.—
tree.text: If the corporation does not comply with any provision of this chapter, the charter granted by this chapter expires.
